papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q6(a)(ii) has separate 5-mark placements for ω, ε and a, so all three requested parameters are separate tasks, following the scheme’s worked order. Q8(b)(ii) allocates two 5-mark steps to the period and a separate 5-mark step to equivalent length. Q4(b) has one shared final 5-mark bracket for all three tensions and remains one 30-mark task. Q2(a)(i) asks for one velocity; its vector calculation, magnitude and direction are representations of that same requested quantity. Q7(a) uses Hooke’s law and the canonical SHM/Hooke node, while Q7(b) is statics. The scheme uses a rebound value 1/√2 in Q3(b)(ii); the original solution remains visible.

papers.boundaryReview: Q2(v) has separate 5-mark placements for the distances travelled by ships A and B, so it is split. Q4(a)(i) paired force diagrams share one 10-mark placement. Q5(i) paired speeds share one final 10-mark placement after the momentum and restitution equations. Q7(a) the two tensions share the final 5-mark placement. These joint answers remain one task each. Q3(v) the two times are the two roots of one jointly marked quadratic solution. Q8(a)(i) includes both the preparatory angular velocity and the requested acceleration, with two 10-mark placements. Review correction: Q6(b) has separately priced x and y coordinate outputs. The original card ID is retained for x and the shared area work; y has its own 5-mark card.
